envelope.text: ADOPT-BOUNDED: nano-ros's options carry the scheduling context and the message-info flag, not rcl's `qos`,

why: ADOPTED 2026-10-28 (phase-515 C6, maintainer choice "adopt, all six"): `rcl_subscription_get_options` returns a pointer to the options the handle was initialised with, held ON the handle -- all zero for an init without options, NULL for a NULL or unusable handle, as rcl returns NULL for an invalid one. ENVELOPE (stated on the declaration): nano-ros's options struct is not rcl's -- the readback carries the scheduling context and the message-info flag; rcl's `qos`, `allocator` and rmw-specific options are not members, so a ported `->qos` fails to compile rather than reading a wrong value, and the handle's QoS stays the one it was created with. Cost: the options struct moves onto the handle, replacing the copied `sched_context_id` where there was one (measured in the phase doc's C6 note). Test: `packages/api/nros-c/tests/run/entity_get_options.c` (`just check c`). PRIOR ROW: see `c:publisher_get_options`.
